title: CISA CTEP：分支情境矩陣與未演練決策路徑
titleEn: CISA CTEP: scenario-branch matrices and unexercised decision paths
subcategoryTitle: 事件演練、服務恢復與可驗證交接
subcategoryTitleEn: Incident exercises, service recovery and verifiable handoffs
summary: 將證據可用、主要聯絡角色可用、備份驗證通過三個二元因素列出全部組合，為每組寫預期決策、停止條件與觀察證據。
summaryEn: Enumerate all combinations of three binary factors: evidence availability, primary-contact availability and backup-verification success. Define expected decisions, stop conditions and observable evidence for each combination.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

stages.title: 列出三個情境因素
stages.description: 桌上演練反覆練習同一條順利路徑，參與者都簽到卻未遇過證據缺失或接手角色缺席；本課用分支矩陣設計不同注入卡。 將證據可用、主要聯絡角色可用、備份驗證通過三個二元因素列出全部組合，為每組寫預期決策、停止條件與觀察證據。 將上述邊界、欄位與負責角色畫成一頁輸入到輸出的證據圖，對照來源文件定位需要保留的語意。 把八格組合鍵寫成三個明確布林值，主持人逐格準備可觀察輸入，參與者不可提前看到標準答案。另保存facilitator_prompted，使接受提示後成功與無提示成功分開，而不影響是否曾演練該格的紀錄。
stages.descriptionEn: A tabletop repeatedly follows the same successful path. Everyone attends, yet missing evidence and unavailable delegates are never exercised; a branch matrix designs distinct inject cards rather than relying on attendance. Enumerate all combinations of three binary factors: evidence availability, primary-contact availability and backup-verification success. Define expected decisions, stop conditions and observable evidence for each combination. Draw a one-page evidence map from those inputs to outputs, identify the responsible roles, and locate the corresponding semantic contract in the cited project documentation. Represent each of eight cells with three explicit Boolean factors and prepare observable inputs for the facilitator, without revealing expected answers to participants in advance. Preserve facilitator_prompted to separate assisted success from unaided success while keeping an independent record that the branch was exercised at all.
